question: Do existing per-sample description quality scores strictly identify the frozen v4 fixed60 descriptions?
required_match: same original O description content with SHA256 or equivalent verifiable source binding

search_scope.existing_source_reference_followed: configs/arr_followup_v1.yaml parent_experiment and tools/plot_experiment_figures.py description metric paths

historical_per_sample_candidates.reason: Building IDs and dimension fields overlap, but no description/GT content hashes bind these historical scores to the frozen inputs. Matching three dimensions cannot prove full description identity; the original referenced score file is unavailable.

Building IDs overlap, but no description/GT content hashes bind these historical scores to the frozen inputs; dimensional fields prove some descriptions differ. Matching numeric dimensions alone cannot prove full description identity.

other_exclusions.reason: Human reconstruction submission metrics, including validation placeholders; no description quality/provider matching.
Historical aggregate correlations, not source-bound fixed60 per-sample scores.
Historical aggregate/case correlation report, not content-bound score provenance.
Historical 200-building/model-average results cannot be joined to fixed960.

conclusion: Existing historical per-sample quality scores were found, but strict matching to the current frozen descriptions fails. No RQ2 correlations, bootstrap, or three-model-average regression are reported. Old v5 and historical Builder outcomes are not merged.
no_api_followup: A future, explicitly specified CPU-only score protocol could score the hashed saved descriptions against the same GT, with a new provenance-bound artifact and exploratory analysis label; that would be newly derived evidence, not proof that historical scores were matched.
